title: Agentic AI — July 2026
brief: An executive deck, entirely in English, on the state of agentic AI as of July 2026: what an agent actually is now (the settled model/harness/protocol vocabulary), the four-layer stack (frontier models, agent CLIs, MCP/ACP/A2A interop, deployment surfaces), what changed in H1 2026 (model cadence, the Codex surge, the Anthropic repricing episode, the $60B SpaceX-Cursor deal, the MCP release candidate), benchmark evidence (SWE-bench Verified, OSWorld vs the human baseline, GAIA's model-vs-system spread), adoption data, the vendor landscape, unit economics, the four structural risks, and six dated calls for the next 12 months. Every number is grounded in July-2026 web sources, cited on-slide with a full sources slide.
da: Swiss editorial print — warm off-white paper, near-black ink, one vermilion accent, Archivo grotesk, oversized numerals, hairline rules, completely flat.
